builds.summary: Corrupt Intervention stalls the start; then Pop Goes the Weasel boosts kicks after hooks, Eruption explodes kicked generators on downs and Pain Resonance hits the leading generator on each Survivor's first Scourge Hook.

A generator can take at most 8 regression events per trial (a kick with Pop counts as one), so spread your kicks across generators.

builds.title: The Luck Build
builds.summary: Leave the match to the dice: Dramaturgy's random outcome, Bardic Inspiration's d20 for team skill checks, and Up the Ante's luck and self-unhooks for everyone.
builds.details: While healthy and running, press the Active Ability button for Dramaturgy: you get 25% Haste for 2 s and 40 s of Exhausted, then a random result (more Haste, Exposed for 12 s, a random rare item with add-ons, or a scream that does nothing), never the same one twice in a row. While idle, press the Active Ability button to perform Bardic Inspiration for up to 15 s for survivors within 16 m (others see your aura meanwhile); a d20 roll sets the bonus progress their basic skill checks give, from +1% to +3% or nothing on the lowest roll, for 90 s if you complete the performance (cooldown 90 s). Up the Ante makes all survivors 3% luckier for each other survivor alive and lets every survivor attempt to unhook themselves. Slippery Meat is the one sure thing: other survivors unhook you faster and you gain 5% more Haste when unhooked.
tips: Article last updated December 2024; perk effects have since been adjusted, but all four perks still exist.
Slippery Meat's current text has no luck effect: other survivors unhook you faster and you gain more Haste when unhooked.

builds.summary: Four ways to send the killer somewhere you are not: a fake survivor, a thrown pebble, a generator alert from a locker and a fake locker entry.
builds.details: Once you have repaired 20% of generators, press the Secondary Ability button next to a chest, exit gate switch, generator or totem to leave a static illusion for 60 s with Mirrored Illusion. Charge Diversion while the killer is close but not chasing you: it needs time spent hiding inside the terror radius.

tips: Article last updated December 2024.
Every trap shows its generator or pallet to all survivors while it is armed.
Any Means Necessary has no repair requirement, so you can use it on dropped pallets from the start of the match.
